english.title: Fail to deliver election expenses return or declaration to appropriate officer
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were guilty of an illegal practice in that you failed to deliver or send

(A)_[a declaration accompanying an expenses return]_
(B)_[an expenses return]_
(C)_[a copy of an expenses return]_

as required by section 75 of the Representation of the People Act 1983 in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 75(5) and 169 of the Representation of the People Act 1983.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex see section 176Note
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
